global_style: bright warm home lighting, mixed natural and overhead light, UGC mobile photography style, visible living traces, slight messy aesthetic

shots.description: Medium shot, fixed camera, Malay hijab woman holding one baby, right hand pulling black metal handle of white wardrobe.
Medium shot, fixed camera, massive dark clothes falling from wardrobe, Malay hijab woman holding baby leaning backward with surprise.
Full shot, slight camera shake, brown-haired woman in beige T-shirt and black jeans falling backward onto clothes pile, legs raised.
shots.voiceover: Subject falling onto the clothing pile.

shots.description: Medium close-up, downward tilt, same brown-haired woman sitting up among clothes, palms facing outward.
Medium close-up, slight zoom in, hands opening gray-white striped soft fabric storage bag with dark gray zipper and handles, placing it on lap or floor.
Close-up, fixed overhead shot, hands moving downward, grabbing folded clothes, stacking neatly inside gray-white striped soft storage bag.
shots.voiceover: Stacking folded clothes inside the bag.

shots.description: Extreme close-up, fixed camera, hands pinching double zipper sliders, sliding horizontally to close gray-white striped soft storage bag, grabbing gray side handles, lifting upward.
shots.voiceover: Closing the bag and lifting the handles.
